newsitem.title: USA: Estee Lauder sees 20 pct EPS growth in FY97.
newsitem.headline: Estee Lauder sees 20 pct EPS growth in FY97.

text.p: Estee Lauder Cos Inc said on Wednesday it expects to increase earnings by 20 percent in fiscal year 1997 and reiterated its expectation to meet analysts' estimates of $1.40 for the year.
"We expect 20 percent earnings growth in current fiscal year will be met," said Robert Bigler, the company's chief financial officer.

The company posted results for fiscal year 1996, ended June 30, of $160.4 miilion, or $1.17 per share, a 32 percent increase from $121.2 million in fiscal 1995. The company went public in November, 1995.
Speaking at an investors' conference here, Bigler said the fragrance and cosmetics company is keeping a keen eye out for further acquisitions.

Leonard Lauder, chairman and chief executive, said the company plans to expand its recently acquired high-end brands like Bobbi Brown and M.A.C., in which the company has a majority interest, "slowly but surely" on a worldwide basis.
"Our limited distribution strategy is working for us," he said.
